title: Open and use the mobile menu
preconditions: The local app is running and the doctor check passes.

steps.action: Open / at 390 x 844 and activate the menu toggle.
steps.expected: A mobile navigation panel opens, the toggle reports expanded, and the same five destinations are listed.

steps.action: Choose About from the mobile panel.
steps.expected: The About page renders and the panel closes.

steps.action: Open the panel and activate the close control.
steps.expected: The panel closes and the toggle reports collapsed.
